qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialty chemical and ingredient distributor lacks proprietary product IP, as chemical principals own the formulations and can terminate or insource mandates. Margin compression and organic EBITA erosion in 2024-2025 post-shortage normalization drove GAAP ROIC down to 8.9%, failing the 12% proof of moat hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Specialty chemical distributor lacks structural pricing power; product IP is owned by chemical manufacturers who can bypass distributors on high-volume lines. Normalization after post-COVID supply shortage windfalls resulted in organic EBITA declines and drove GAAP ROIC to 8.9% in 2025, below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC deteriorated from 14.5% in 2022 to 12.3% in 2024 and 8.88% in 2025. Operating EBIT fell from €463.5M in 2022 to €360.9M in 2025. Operating EBITA dropped 6% reported in 2025 amid soft industrial chemical demand, while balance sheet debt expanded to €1.29B (net debt ~€1.05B) to fund roll-up M&A.
